items.title: 4.2 Python mein databases ke saath kaam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.2 (PDF 56-60), rewritten 2026-10-28 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Python mein databases ke saath kaam ka matlab hai database systems mein data rakhna aur sambhalna. Python programs databases se jur kar data dal (insert), nikal (retrieve), badal (update) aur mita (delete) sakte hain. Databases applications ko bohat zyada maloomat achhi tarah sambhalne dete hain aur data ko durust aur yaksan (consistent) rakhte hain. Python built-in aur bahar ki (external) libraries ke zariye database ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Databases programs ko bohat si maloomat mehfooz tareeqe se rakhne aur zaroorat par jaldi nikalne dete hain.
Databases ka ta'aruf

Database data ka munazzam majmua (organized collection) hai jo aik tay shuda banawat (structured format) mein rakha jata hai. Is se data tak pohanchna aur use sambhalna aasan hota hai. Databases aik hi data ki baar baar nakal (duplication) kam karte hain aur bharosa (reliability) barhate hain. Yeh maloomat ko mehfooz rakhte hain aur bohat si qism ke software mein istemal hote hain.
Entity: asal duniya ki koi cheez, shakhs, jagah, waqia (event) ya tasawwur (concept) jis ka data database mein rakha jata hai.
Misal: Student, Teacher, Course, Book, Employee
Attribute: entity ki koi khusoosiyat (property ya characteristic). Yeh entity ke bare mein khaas maloomat batata hai.
Misal: Student entity ke attributes yeh ho sakte hain:

items: Student Name (naam)
Roll Number
Class
Age (umar)

blocks.text: Relationship: batata hai ke do ya zyada entities aapas mein kaise juri hain.
Misal: Student Course mein dakhla leta hai (enrols in). Yahan 'enrols in' Student aur Course ke darmiyan relationship hai.
Identifier: woh attribute jo entity ke har record ya object ki alag (unique) pehchan kare.
Misal: Student entity mein Roll Number identifier ban sakta hai kyunke har student ka roll number alag hota hai.

blocks.alt: Student entity ka dabba; baayein taraf us ke attributes ke ovals: Roll Number (neeche lakeer, identifier), Name, Class, Age. Student se 'enrols in' relationship ka diamond Course entity tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Entity, attribute, relationship aur identifier (hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.text: Databases ko samajhna
Databases woh zaroori data rakhte hain jo application chalane ke liye chahiye, aur applications ko bare data sets achhi tarah sambhalne dete hain. Database ke aham concepts yeh hain:

items: Relational Database: aisa database jo data tables (rows aur columns) mein rakhta hai aur tables ko relationships se jorta hai.
Table: mutalliq data ka majmua jo rows (records) aur columns (fields) mein munazzam hota hai (Figure 4.3).
Column: entity ki koi khusoosiyat (maslan name, age).
Primary Key: table ke har record ki alag (unique) pehchan.
Foreign Key: aisi field jo doosre table ki primary key ka hawala de kar aik table ko doosre se jorti hai.

blocks.alt: Do tables. Table: Student ke columns RollNo, Name, Age, DeptID; rows 101 Kiran 20 1; 102 Ibrahim 21 2; 103 M Kamal 20 1; 104 Zainab 22 3. Table: Department ke columns DeptID, DeptName; rows 1 Computer Science; 2 Electronics; 3 Mechanical. Nishanat: Column (Attribute), Field (Attribute Value), Record (Tuple), RollNo aur Department DeptID ke neeche Primary Key, aur Student DeptID se Department ki primary key tak lakeer par Foreign Key.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.3: Tables, columns, records, fields, primary key aur foreign key ka rishta (kitab ki Figure 4.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Relational databases aur SQL ki banawat

Relational databases data ko rows aur columns wale tables mein rakhte hain. Har table mutalliq data ko munazzam tareeqe se rakhta hai. Tables ke darmiyan rishte (relationships) keys ke zariye qaim rehte hain. SQL ka matlab Structured Query Language hai; yeh databases se baat cheet ke liye istemal hoti hai. SQL commands data banane, parhne, badalne aur mitane mein madad deti hain.
Python ko database se jorna

Python ko database se jorne se program mehfooz (stored) data ke saath kaam kar sakta hai. Data ka koi bhi kaam karne se pehle database connection zaroori hai. Python aisi libraries deta hai jo yeh connection aasani se banati hain. Jurne ke baad data dala, nikala ya badla ja sakta hai. Connection ko theek tarah sambhalne se Python aur database ke darmiyan baat cheet aasani se chalti hai.
sqlite3 ya MySQL se database connection banana

sqlite3 library Python mein built-in hai aur chhote databases ke liye istemal hoti hai. Yeh sara data system par aik hi file mein rakhti hai. MySQL bare aur pecheeda database systems ke liye istemal hota hai. Connection banane ke liye database ki tafseelat di jati hain, jaise naam aur credentials (username, password). Connection kamyab ho to Python database istemal kar sakta hai.

# Import sqlite3 module
import sqlite3
# Connect to the database file named "school.db"
# If the file does not exist, SQLite will create it automatically
connection = sqlite3.connect("school.db")
# Create a cursor object
# Cursor is used to execute SQL queries
cursor = connection.cursor()
# Create "students" table if it does not exist
cursor.execute(""" CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS students
 ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,  name TEXT, age INTEGER, grade TEXT ) """)
# (Optional) Insert sample data
cursor.execute ("INSERT INTO students (name, age, grade) VALUES ('Ali', 14, '8th')")
cursor.execute ("INSERT INTO students (name, age, grade) VALUES ('Sara', 15, '9th')")
# Save changes
connection.commit()
# This query selects all columns (*) from the table named "students"
cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM students")
# Fetch all records returned by the query
# fetchall() returns a list of rows/records
records = cursor.fetchall()
# Display all records
# Loop through each row in the records list
for row in records:
    # Print each row of the table
    print(row)
# Close the database connection
connection.close()

items: Connect to Database: school.db SQLite database se connection banata hai.
Create Cursor: cursor object banata hai jo SQL commands chalata hai.
Execute Query: SQL query chala kar students table ke tamam records lata hai.
Fetch and Display Data: fetchall() tamam records le aata hai aur har row print hoti hai.
Close Connection: kaam ke baad database connection band karta hai.

blocks.alt: sqlite3 misal ke chhe qadam do rows mein: 1 connect (sqlite3.connect('school.db')), 2 cursor (connection.cursor()), 3 execute (cursor.execute(sql)), 4 commit (connection.commit()), 5 fetch (cursor.fetchall()), 6 close (connection.close()).

blocks.title: Misal do dafa chalana
blocks.text: INSERT lines har dafa program chalne par chalti hain, is liye doosri dafa chalane par Ali aur Sara naye ids ke saath dobara shamil ho jate hain. Asli programs dalne se pehle jaanchte hain, ya sirf user ke kehne par dalte hain.
Python se SQL commands chalana

Python se database ke saath kaam SQL commands se hota hai. Python yeh commands database cursor ke zariye bhejta hai. Commands se tables banaye ya data dala ja sakta hai, aur SELECT queries se data nikala bhi ja sakta hai. SQL commands chala kar Python programs database ka data achhi tarah sambhalte hain.
CRUD Operations

CRUD ka matlab Create, Read, Update aur Delete hai; yeh database ke bunyadi kaam hain. Inhi se database mein rakha data sambhala jata hai (Figure 4.4 aur Table 4.1). Har database wali application CRUD operations par chalti hai; yeh maloomat ko durust aur taaza (up-to-date) rakhte hain. Python yeh kaam SQL commands se karta hai.

blocks.alt: students naam ka table, columns ID, Name, Age; rows 1 Ibrahim 25; 2 Zainab 30; 3 Kiran 28. Chaar buttons us ki taraf ishara karte hain: Create (INSERT...), Read (SELECT...), Update (UPDATE...) aur Delete (DELETE...).
blocks.caption: Figure 4.4: Table par Create, Read, Update aur Delete operations (kitab ki Figure 4.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
Table 4.1: CRUD operations
rows: INSERT INTO students (ID, Name, Age) VALUES (1, 'John', 20);
Table mein naya record dalta hai.
Table se data nikalta hai (SQL mein yeh kaam SELECT command karti hai).
UPDATE students SET Age = 21 WHERE ID = 1;
Table ka maujooda record badalta hai.

blocks.text: Create: naye records dalna

Create operation database table mein naya data dalta hai, jaise naam, values ya records. Is ke liye SQL INSERT commands istemal hoti hain. Python yeh commands database ko bhejta hai, aur chalne ke baad naye records mehfooz data ka hissa ban jate hain.
Read: data nikalna aur dikhana

Read operation database se data lata hai aur zaroorat par mehfooz records dikhata hai. Data parhne ke liye aam taur par SQL SELECT commands istemal hoti hain. Python nataij le kar un par kaam (process) karta hai. Yeh operation mehfooz data ko nahi badalta.
Update: maujooda records badalna

Update operation database ke maujooda data ko badalta hai. Yeh tab istemal hota hai jab rakhi hui maloomat durust karni ho. SQL UPDATE commands chune hue records badalti hain; Python yeh commands shart (condition, jaise WHERE ID = 1) ke mutabiq chalata hai. Is mein sirf bataya gaya data badalta hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Kisi student ke marks update karein aur naya (updated) data dikhayein.
Delete: data mehfooz tareeqe se mitana

Delete operation database se ghair zaroori data mitata hai aur database ko saaf aur durust rakhta hai. SQL DELETE commands shart (condition) ke saath istemal hoti hain, is liye Python sirf chune hue records mitata hai. Ehtiyat se istemal karne se zaroori data zaya nahi hota.
Misal (Example):

import sqlite3
# Connect to the database
connection = sqlite3.connect("school.db")
# Create a cursor object
cursor = connection.cursor()
# Execute DELETE query (example: delete student with ID = 1)
cursor.execute("DELETE FROM students WHERE ID = 1")
# Save changes
connection.commit()
# Display confirmation
print("Record deleted successfully")
# Close the connection
connection.close()
Record deleted successfully
blocks.caption: Output

items: DELETE FROM students WHERE ID = 1 → aik khaas record mitata hai.
connection.commit() → tabdeeli database mein mehfooz karta hai.
commit() ke baghair delete pakka (permanent) nahi hota.

blocks.title: UPDATE aur DELETE ke saath hamesha WHERE shart
blocks.text: WHERE ke baghair DELETE FROM students; har row mita deta hai, aur WHERE ke baghair UPDATE har row badal deta hai. Command chalane se pehle shart jaanch lein.

blocks.title: Users ki qeematein: placeholders use karein
blocks.text: Jab qeematein user se aayein to unhein SQL text mein jorne ke bajaye alag bhejein, maslan cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM students WHERE name = ?", (name,)). ? placeholder likhe gaye text ko command badalne (SQL injection) se rokta hai.

blocks.prompt: students table mein Sara ka grade '10th' karne ka SQL likhein, aur batayein ke baad mein Python ko kya call karna hoga.
blocks.explanation: UPDATE students SET grade = '10th' WHERE name = 'Sara'; phir connection.commit() taake tabdeeli mehfooz ho.

blocks.prompt: Primary key aur foreign key mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Primary key apne table ke har record ki munfarid pehchan hai (jaise RollNo); foreign key aik table ki field hai jo tables jorne ke liye doosre table ki primary key rakhti hai (jaise Student mein DeptID).

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Database: munazzam data; entity, attribute, relationship, identifier.
Relational tables: rows (records), columns (fields), primary aur foreign keys; SQL in se kaam karti.
sqlite3: connect, cursor, execute, commit, fetchall, close.
CRUD: INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE (UPDATE aur DELETE ke saath WHERE).
